review.instruction: Verify current-state records the bound backend head and source evidence before any proposal or selection was written.

Verify exactly one alternative is selected; every boundary owns named stores or explicitly owns none; every store has one accountable owner; shared writers are justified; and every committed write is declared once with writer, transport, stores, transaction boundary, idempotency, migrations and business dimensions.
Verify every retained component has evidence for runtime version, deployable unit, communication failure, datastore ownership, and backup and restore. Existing use alone is not justification.

Verify a fresh independent critique attacks the selected design and a materially different alternative on the frozen axes, names uncertainties, and every adverse finding is answered or the response remains mismatch.

failurePolicy: Record the concrete failed criterion and evidence. Revise only the affected observation, alternative, stack-model section or critique answer, then reassess; never rerun unchanged analysis or publish a failing decision.
